7d37254ad4fb7bf7.description: Job description About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. Position Overview : The Plant NVH Technician supports manufacturing quality operations by performing vehicle evaluations, operating NVH testing equipment, collecting diagnostic data, and assisting with production issue investigations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring vehicles meet Noise, Vibration, and Harshness quality standards prior to customer delivery. The ideal candidate possesses strong automotive diagnostic experience, attention to detail, and the ability to identify vehicle quality concerns through both objective measurements and subjective evaluations. Key Responsibilities : Vehicle Evaluation & Testing Perform EOL NVH inspections and evaluations on production vehicles. Conduct subjective assessments of vehicle noise, vibration, and overall refinement. Execute standardized NVH test procedures and quality checks. Verify and document vehicle concerns identified by automated screening systems. Data Collection & Diagnostics Install and operate microphones, accelerometers, and related diagnostic equipment. Collect vehicle data using SCADAS, Squadriga, and other acquisition systems. Support engineering investigations through repeatable data collection and testing. Assist in diagnosing airborne noise, vibration, and BSR concerns. Production Support Support vehicle containment and troubleshooting activities. Assist engineering teams with root cause investigations. Document findings and maintain accurate records of test results. Support launch, pilot, and production validation activities. Equipment Maintenance Maintain NVH testing equipment and work areas. Perform routine equipment inspections and calibration verification. Identify and report equipment issues. Ensure testing equipment remains operational and compliant with established procedures. Documentation & Reporting Record test results accurately and completely. Maintain issue tracking and investigation documentation. Preferred candidate Years of experience 1+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

7d39191da96dd262.description: About the Role AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is seeking a Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in central Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires over 10 years of experience. The role is central to AWS's growth strategy in the Kingdom, supporting digital transformation initiatives driven by Vision 2030 across various sectors. Role Overview The Solutions Architect serves as a key technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise customers. This involves assisting them in modernizing legacy platforms, adopting AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerating their digital agendas. Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. The role requires strategic thinking about business, products, and technical challenges, operating at the intersection of technology and business. Key Responsibilities Support long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions, in partnership with Account Managers and Business Development. Act as a technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Riyadh and central Saudi Arabia region, building relationships with stakeholders and contributing to their technology strategy. Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful cloud deployment, including competitive migration paths. Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS. Capture and share best-practice knowledge within the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures. Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support, gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and collaborating with fellow Solutions Architects. Required Qualifications Over 10 years of relevant experience. Broad competence across multiple technology areas, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, and data analytics. Demonstrated depth in at least one to two of the aforementioned technology areas. Ability to connect technology solutions with measurable business value for customer success. Experience interacting with various customer stakeholders, including Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers. A Day in the Life A typical day involves reviewing architecture proposals for enterprise customers, participating in technical sessions with engineering teams to design application platforms, and advising on the appropriate mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services. Collaboration with Account Managers and account teams on strategy calls, contributing to technical win plans, and identifying specialist resources are also key activities. The role includes supporting workshops or Immersion Days for developers at customer sites, focusing on topics such as Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernization with EKS. Between meetings, tasks may include capturing product feedback, contributing to blog posts, or reviewing architectures with teammates. Internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, knowledge-sharing sessions, and event preparation are also part of the weekly routine. About the Team The AWS Global Sales team drives the adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide. The team focuses on enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud by providing tailored service, technology, and consistent support. This involves understanding each customer's challenges and crafting solutions to accelerate their success. The team's customer-first approach has contributed to AWS becoming a widely adopted cloud platform.

7d8d4bf1fa66740b.description: Job description 1. Why This Role Matters The Lead Specialist, Governance & Master Data strengthens Ma’aden’s ability to treat data as a trusted enterprise asset. The role establishes the standards, ownership, controls, and master data foundations required for reliable reporting, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and business decision-making. The role creates value by improving the accuracy, consistency, traceability, and usability of critical data across business functions and technology platforms. Strong governance and master data practices reduce operational inefficiency, limit data-related risk, improve regulatory and audit readiness, and enable teams to make decisions with greater confidence. As a specialist authority, the role turns enterprise governance requirements into practical controls, clear accountabilities, and sustainable ways of working. The role also builds a culture in which data owners, stewards, and users understand their responsibilities and actively improve the quality and value of Ma’aden’s information assets. 2. What You Will Deliver Enterprise Data Governance Establish governance frameworks, policies, standards, and decision rights that strengthen ownership and accountability for critical data. Align governance practices with enterprise data strategy, architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory obligations. Embed governance into business processes and technology delivery rather than applying controls after implementation. Master Data Excellence Govern master data definitions, hierarchies, business rules, and lifecycle controls across critical domains such as assets, materials, suppliers, and employees. Improve master data consistency across systems to reduce duplication, reconciliation effort, and process disruption. Enable trusted master data that supports efficient operations, integrated reporting, analytics, and automation. Data Quality, Metadata & Traceability Define measurable quality rules and controls for completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and timeliness. Drive root-cause resolution of recurring data issues and track improvements through agreed quality indicators. Strengthen data discoverability and trust through effective metadata, lineage, cataloguing, and traceability practices. Governed Platforms & Digital Enablement Integrate data quality, ownership, security, metadata, and lineage controls into data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics platforms. Enable scalable and governed data foundations for reporting, advanced analytics, AI, and digital initiatives. Apply automation and analytics to improve control effectiveness, issue detection, and governance efficiency. Risk, Compliance & Assurance Identify and mitigate governance, privacy, security, and master data risks before they affect business performance. Maintain evidence-based controls that strengthen regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and accountability. Monitor adherence to governance standards and drive corrective action where control gaps are identified. Adoption & Capability Building Equip data owners, stewards, analysts, and technology teams with practical playbooks, procedures, and governance guidance. Influence business and technology stakeholders to adopt master data standards and accountable data practices. Build sustainable governance capability through mentoring, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement. 3. What Success Looks Like Critical data domains achieve agreed improvements in completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and timeliness. Master data standards and hierarchies are consistently adopted across priority systems and business processes. Recurring data issues, duplicate records, reconciliation effort, and control exceptions reduce over time. Critical data assets have clearly assigned owners and stewards, supported by documented accountability. Metadata, lineage, and catalogue coverage improve for priority data assets, increasing traceability and user confidence. Analytics, AI, reporting, and automation initiatives use governed data that meets defined quality and compliance requirements. 4. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 5. Experience 8–10 years of relevant experience in data governance, master data management, or enterprise data management. Experience implementing enterprise data governance and master data management frameworks. Experience establishing data quality, stewardship, metadata, lineage, or data catalogue capabilities within a complex organization. Experience translating governance requirements into practical business processes and technology controls. 6. Skills That Matter Functional Expertise Enterprise Data Governance Master Data Management Data Quality Management Metadata & Data Catalogue Management Data Lineage & Traceability Data Stewardship & Lifecycle Management Business & Delivery Governance Framework Design Policy, Standards & Control Development Data Risk & Compliance Management Governance Performance Measurement Root-Cause Analysis & Remediation Continuous Improvement & Automation People & Collaboration Stakeholder Management & Influence Business and Technology Collaboration Governance Advisory Facilitation & Communication Coaching & Knowledge Transfer Change Adoption & Accountability Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

7d32881f744c1a18.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية، بالإضافة إلى تقييم الأداء وتنمية المهارات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال ونشاطات موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات الموظفين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري ومنظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأعمال بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة مجموعة المجال العربي. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. معلومات إضافية تُعد هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمحترفين الذين يسعون إلى المساهمة في تحسين وتطوير عمليات الخدمات العامة، والعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تدعم النمو المهني.

All tasks must be carried out with strict adherence to established safety procedures and work instructions to ensure efficient and effective operations within the plant. Key Responsibilities Ensure all duties are performed in a safe, efficient, and effective manner, complying with NOMAC safety rules and regulations. 7d3ed438510dffa1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سول العربية التجارية عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقًا للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مدى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. نطاق الدور يتضمن الدور متابعة عمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج، ومراقبة سير العمل فيها، ووضع وتتبع موازناتها وإجراءاتها التعاقدية. كما يشمل تحديد تكاليف المشاريع ومصادر تمويلها، ومتابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجازها وتحقيق أهدافها بناءً على الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمنهجيات إدارة المشاريع وأفضل الممارسات. القدرة على الإشراف على فرق العمل وتوجيهها بفعالية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سول العربية التجارية. يتيح هذا الدور فرصة للمساهمة في إدارة مشاريع وبرامج حيوية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

7d5bdb0cabe22c78.description: Job Summary Khatib & Alami is seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to join its Project Management Consultancy (PMC) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves administering a complex portfolio of contracts, specifically the FIDIC Conditions of Contract for Construction (Red Book), FIDIC Conditions of Contract for Plant & Design-Build (Yellow Book), and Lead Design Consultant Service Agreements. Role Overview Reporting directly to the Project Manager, the Contract Administrator will serve as key personnel from the PMC, acting as The Engineer or Employer’s Representative. This position is responsible for managing the commercial and contractual obligations of multiple parties, navigating the distinct risk profiles associated with standard construction (Red Book remeasurement and Employer-led design), Contractor-led design-build (Yellow Book lumpsum and fitness-for-purpose), and professional services (Consultant standard of care and design deliverables). The role focuses on safeguarding the Employer’s interests through rigorous notice management, claim evaluation, change control, and interface management between design and construction teams. Key Responsibilities Administer contracts in strict accordance with FIDIC Red Book, FIDIC Yellow Book, Lead Design Consultant Agreements, and applicable laws. Interpret diverse contract terms, conditions, specifications, and scope boundaries for the PMC team and Employer. Ensure all parties comply with their respective contractual obligations and procedural timelines. Manage contractual boundaries and liability hand-offs between the Lead Design Consultant and Construction Contractors, particularly regarding design coordination, clarifications, and construction-phase design support. Monitor the "Review Period" for Contractor’s Documents to prevent "deemed approvals." Administer remeasurement processes, bill of quantities (BOQ) variations, and manage risks associated with Employer/Consultant-provided design delivery to the Contractor. Monitor the Lead Design Consultant’s adherence to deliverable schedules, standard of care obligations, and professional indemnity requirements. Maintain meticulous records of all contract correspondence, instructions, variations, and decisions. Draft clear, contractually sound, and objective responses to incoming letters. Evaluate Milestone Payment Applications and Interim Payment Certificates against contractual provisions. Administer the Variation Procedure across all contracts, evaluating the impact of scope changes. Prepare and coordinate with the Employer to issue Variation Orders. Essential • Hands-on FircoSoft tuning experience - filter configuration, matching algorithms, rules and threshold calibration (not oversight of a team that did it). • Professional fluency in Arabic and English, with practical experience of Arabic name-screening challenges: transliteration, romanisation variants and script matching. • Strong sanctions compliance knowledge - UN, OFAC, EU and UK regimes and screening obligations, and the governance expectations around filter effectiveness. • Experience of screening effectiveness testing and documentation to a standard that withstands model validation, audit and regulatory review. • Banking or financial institution experience, with the stakeholder skills to work across Compliance, Operations, Technology and the vendor.
